chain.label: Dark night with minimal outside visual references
chain.trigger: evening civil twilight ended about 22 minutes before the accident; only 8 percent of the moon disk was illuminated and a scattered to broken layer of low stratiform clouds lay over the Gulf

chain.label: Helicopter not equipped with, or required to have, a TAWS
chain.trigger: the accident helicopter was not equipped with a TAWS and was not required by Federal regulations to be so equipped

chain.label: Helicopter enters an unexplained, unarrested descent
chain.trigger: the helicopter started to descend at a rate of about 300 feet per minute [and] remained... descending... its rate of descent was about 250 fpm

chain.label: Flight crew fails to monitor instruments and misses descent cues
chain.trigger: the flight crew was not adequately monitoring the helicopter's altitude and missed numerous cues to indicate that the helicopter was inadvertently descending toward the water

caused_by.evidence: few, if any, references outside of the helicopter would have been available to the flight crew

chain.label: Helicopter strikes the Gulf of Mexico (controlled flight into terrain)
chain.trigger: crashed into the Gulf of Mexico about 70 nautical miles south-southeast of... GLS

caused_by.evidence: if the helicopter had continued its 250-fpm descent from 1,100 feet msl, it would have crashed into the water
the flight crew's failure to identify and arrest the helicopter's descent for undetermined reasons, which resulted in controlled flight into terrain

if a TAWS had been installed aboard the accident helicopter, the system's aural and visual warnings should have provided the flight crew with ample time to recognize that the helicopter was descending toward the water, initiate the necessary corrective actions, and recover from the descent

chain.label: Captain, copilot, and eight passengers killed
chain.trigger: The captain, copilot, and eight passengers aboard the helicopter were killed

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter was destroyed by impact forces
